_readme: Copy to durig.config.json (gitignored). Environment variables override these values. Verify with: node cli.mjs config
_paths_note: DURIG_DB is relative to the working directory you run cli.mjs from; an absolute path avoids ambiguity.
_extensions_note: The team's own verbs live on the extension plane (D212): extensions/self-merge.mjs gives a seat `landing_health` and `land_my_item`, and arms the `ready-ref-stale` check rule (SLA default 24 h, override DURIG_SELF_MERGE_SLA_HOURS). The base ships with NONE armed - copy this file and keep the two entries to run the team, drop them to run durian-core.
